title: Height of a balanced binary tree
text: A binary tree has 31 nodes and is perfectly balanced. What is its height if the root is at level 0?
concept: In a perfect binary tree, the number of nodes is 2^(h+1) − 1 when the root is at level 0 and the height is h.
hints: Write the relationship between the number of nodes and height.
Add 1 to both sides, then identify the power of 2.
guidance: Translate the wording into the standard node-count formula.
Isolate the exponential term before comparing powers.

title: Asymptotic growth
text: Which function grows fastest as n tends to infinity?
concept: Exponential functions with a base greater than 1 eventually grow faster than fixed-degree polynomial and logarithmic functions.
hints: Group the choices by logarithmic, polynomial, and exponential growth.
Compare the exponential option with the polynomial options for large n.
guidance: Classify each expression before comparing them.
Use asymptotic growth classes rather than substituting a small n.
illustration: Typical ordering: log n < n < n log n < n² < cⁿ (for c > 1).

title: Logical implication
text: For propositions p and q, when is p → q false?
options: p is true and q is false
p is false and q is true
answerKey: p is true and q is false
concept: Material implication is equivalent to ¬p ∨ q.
hints: A disjunction is false only when both parts are false.
guidance: Rewrite the implication using a standard logical equivalence.
Find the assignment that makes the entire disjunction false.
illustration: Truth table checkpoint: implication has one false row.

title: Array indexing
text: An array uses zero-based indexing. What is the index of its 8th element?
concept: With zero-based indexing, the first element has index 0.
hints: Write the index of the first and second elements.
The index is one less than the position counted from 1.
guidance: Separate the human position number from the zero-based index.
